display.purpose: Hero headlines, landing page titles. Fraunces only.

headline.purpose: Section headings, page titles. Fraunces only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(97% 0.005 75); background: oklch(52% 0.09 145); border: none; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(20% 0.02 75 / 0.05); transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(44% 0.08 145); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px oklch(20% 0.02 75 / 0.07); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(65% 0.1 175); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(18% 0.014 75); background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid oklch(86% 0.012 75); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(20% 0.02 75 / 0.05); transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: oklch(93% 0.008 75); border-color: oklch(76% 0.016 75); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(65% 0.1 175); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Standard text input with focus and error states.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(18% 0.014 75); background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid oklch(86% 0.012 75); border-radius: 12px; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(64% 0.02 75); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: oklch(76% 0.016 75); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(58% 0.1 175); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(58% 0.1 175 / 0.2); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Content container with subtle border and shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid oklch(86% 0.012 75); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(20% 0.02 75 / 0.05); padding: 20px; transition: box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 12px oklch(20% 0.02 75 / 0.07); border-color: oklch(76% 0.016 75); transform: translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(52% 0.022 75); text-decoration: none; padding: 4px 0; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -2px; width: 100%; height: 2px; background: oklch(52% 0.09 145); border-radius: 9999px; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: oklch(18% 0.014 75); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

components.name: Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(52% 0.09 145); background: oklch(92% 0.05 145); border: 1px solid oklch(52% 0.09 145 / 0.2); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; }

narrative.overview: Eurtisan's visual system evokes a maker's workshop in late-morning light: warm stone, handmade paper, mossy ceramic glazes, and linen curtains. The interface feels grounded, tactile, and European — never sterile, never loud. Every surface celebrates the artisan's craft rather than the platform itself. The system serves a dual-register marketplace: brand surfaces lean into committed warmth and editorial typography, while product surfaces stay restrained and task-focused.
keyCharacteristics: Warm OKLCH palette with moss green primary and sage teal accent
Fraunces display + Manrope body type pairing
4pt spacing scale with semantic token names
Restrained elevation: subtle shadows, tonal layering in dark mode
Full Base UI primitive layer for accessibility

rules.name: The 10% Rule
rules.body: The primary accent (moss green) appears on ≤10% of any product UI screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The No-Purple-No-Orange Rule
rules.body: These hues are explicitly excluded from the palette. They are not used anywhere in the system.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Product UI surfaces use Manrope exclusively. Fraunces is reserved for brand surfaces and display moments.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state or elevation level. Dark mode conveys depth through surface lightness, not shadow.

dos: Do use the 3-layer token architecture (primitive → semantic → component).
Do keep Fraunces for display and Manrope for UI. One family per surface type.
Do use focus-visible with 2px offset rings in sage for all interactive elements.
Do provide skeleton states for content loading, not spinners in the middle of content.
Do handle prefers-reduced-motion with instant state transitions.
Do use semantic token names instead of raw palette names in components.
Do cap body text at 65ch for readability.
Do use tabular-nums for prices and quantities.
donts: Don't use purple or orange anywhere in the palette.
Don't use generic bootstrap marketplace card grids with icon + heading + text, repeated endlessly.
Don't use SaaS-cream minimalism (sterile white/gray/blue defaults).
Don't use dark-mode-terminal aesthetics (cold, technical dark themes).
Don't rely on color alone for state or meaning — always pair with icons, text, or shape.
Don't use outline: none without a focus-visible replacement.
Don't nest cards inside cards. Use spacing and dividers instead.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Use a single solid color.
Don't use glassmorphism as a default treatment.
Don't use side-stripe borders greater than 1px as colored accents.
